item.title: Laws of Existence: Understand, Align, and Harness
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Laws of Existence: Understand, Align, and Harness
#

Wisdom is understanding the laws of existence. Skill is aligning our actions with those laws. Success is harnessing their power without wasted struggle.

None of the laws below was given to humans. None was revealed to humans.

People paid attention. They watched what is outside: nature, society, and the market. They watched what is inside: the dance of the mind, and its restlessness. Thoughts move. Wants rise. Fear does not sit still.
